levels.label: Explicit deletion
levels.allowed_claim: A locally unreferenced direct export can be previewed and explicitly removed with a recovery reference.
levels.forbidden_inference: The symbol is unused by dynamic, reflective, generated, or external consumers.

levels.label: Known consumer refusal
levels.allowed_claim: A known bounded static reference prevents apply.
levels.forbidden_inference: Every consumer class is discoverable by the bounded provider.

levels.label: Stale candidate
levels.allowed_claim: The current packet names stale-candidate refusal as a required next proof.
levels.forbidden_inference: The MVP has already demonstrated stale refusal.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The deletion case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
